agent.problem: Cards 2, 3, 5, 9, 14 and 16 ask the baker to discover wording or an outcome that the earlier cards give no sufficient basis to reason out. Six of the nine choice cards are therefore discoveries, so most of the stop's choices are not informed guesses.

rule.text: A few of those are okay, as long as most choice cards are informed guesses.

agent.problem: Several questions rely on antecedents from cards that are no longer visible. Card 5 says "hard days like that," card 7 says "do all that," card 16 says "If it comes to that," and card 17 says "did this" without identifying the disaster in the question.

rule.text: Always give context in the question. The story card before it isn't on screen anymore, so the question says who and what. Never "him," "that" or "it" pointing back to a card the baker can't see.

agent.problem: The correct answer, that the people forsook the LORD for other gods, was already stated in card 13 and repeated in card 14's setup. Card 17 therefore asks for a cause that an earlier card has already given away.

rule.text: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later.
